mutations.name: DD-CASE
mutations._mechanism: Remove ASCII case folding so uppercase doc-data suffixes are rejected.

mutations.name: DD-SUFFIX
mutations._mechanism: Use Path.suffix so a dotfile named exactly .md loses its qualifying suffix.

mutations.name: DD-ALL
mutations._mechanism: Accept a mixed collection when any name qualifies instead of requiring every name.
mutations.find: return all(has_doc_data_suffix(n) for n in names)  # M:G-DOCDATA-ALL
mutations.replace: return any(has_doc_data_suffix(n) for n in names)  # M:G-DOCDATA-ALL

mutations.name: DD-EMIT
mutations._mechanism: Emit a negative record regardless of the identity's doc-data names.
mutations.find: print("docdata yes" if is_doc_data(identity.names) else "docdata no")  # M:G-DOCDATA-EMIT

mutations.name: DD-EXEMPT-DOCS
mutations._mechanism: Remove the exemption for the project's first-component docs directory.

mutations.name: DD-EXEMPT-DIRS
mutations._mechanism: Remove the tests and fixtures parent-directory exemptions.
mutations.find: return "tests" in parents or "fixtures" in parents  # M:G-EXEMPT-DIRS

mutations.name: DD-EXEMPT-PARENT
mutations._mechanism: Include the basename in directory checks so a file named tests becomes exempt.
